subtitle: Instrument tile match, fully offline
promotional_text: An on-device instrument tile game. Match the hall, collect the order, and keep a private score book.
description: Notehall is a complete offline instrument tile game set in an orchestra hall. Finish onboarding, follow Walk through four moves, run Four Columns to stack tiles, choose a Range for the hall clock, and save a Tablet note. Tap tiles in the collect order to score. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your clock and hall book stay on the device.
app_review_notes: Notehall is a fully offline instrument tile game and private hall book. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four moves, start Four Columns, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. The home board is a playable match. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
